subject.title: [V3.5] Data ficha producto adaptada por idioma del dominio

question: Should R18 proceed as a persisted `Product.translations` data feature after a benchmark, or should maintainers split/defer parts of the title, description, pipeline, and admin scope?
rationale: The remaining work depends on cost/quality tradeoffs, MongoDB storage shape, operational backfill strategy, and admin UX ownership, which automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve staged persisted-translations track
options.body: Run the benchmark first, define the MongoDB/API contract, then split implementation across pipeline, PDP, and admin PRs while keeping this issue open as the tracker.

options.title: Split a PDP-only title suffix slice
options.body: A smaller PR could add suffix rendering before the translation pipeline, but it would leave the core persisted description and admin override requirement unresolved.

options.title: Defer R18
options.body: Keep current localized UI/SEO copy only and postpone product-content translation until cost and catalog-backfill ownership are clearer.

recommendation.title: Approve staged persisted-translations track
recommendation.body: Run the benchmark first, define the MongoDB/API contract, then split implementation across pipeline, PDP, and admin PRs while keeping this issue open as the tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Javier authored the requirement, posted scope updates confirming what remains open, and has recent history on the PDP description surface.
